item.title: [MEDIUM] CVE-2026-55707: In OpenStack Neutron before 28.0.2, the subnetpool onboarding API does not verif...
item.description: In OpenStack Neutron before 28.0.2, the subnetpool onboarding API does not verify ownership of the target subnets. item.description: s2n-quic is a Rust implementation of the QUIC protocol.
